subject: Marketplace pilot: Acme Analytics + Blue Ridge Consulting — AWS listing & co-sell scope
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-analytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@blueridgeconsulting.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot opportunity — AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell with Blue Ridge

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the intro at the summit last week — excited to pick this up. Acme Analytics is ready to pilot a managed listing on AWS Marketplace; our initial ask is: 1) get the listing live for a single offer (hosted container), 2) enable co-sell support (joint GTM with Blue Ridge Consulting), and 3) run a 90-day pilot with basic billing telemetry and lead routing back to our sales team.

High-level constraints: Acme cannot expose customer data; we need PrivateLink/TCB for the first tranche of customers, and we'll need Redwood to confirm PCI/SOC2 evidence for the listing intake. Blue Ridge will lead technical integration and customer enablement.

Can you advise on the quickest path to an intake checklist and required evidence? Also happy to jump on a 30m sync with your marketplace ops and GTM leads next week. Attaching a short product one-pager and proposed pilot acceptance criteria.

Attachments: acme_product-onepager.pdf (stub), acme_pilot-criteria.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
jane.doe@acme-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom@blueridgeconsulting.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot opportunity — AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell with Blue Ridge

Jane — thanks for the clear ask and the materials. Marking internal owners and next steps below.

Quick summary of what Redwood can commit to for a pilot:
- Marketplace intake & listing support: Redwood Marketplace Ops (Ben) will own the offer intake and evidence triage.
- Co-sell enablement: We'll coordinate an initial co-sell play with Blue Ridge and the Redwood Alliances GTM team to define joint targets and lead routing.
- Technical gating: Vivek will validate PrivateLink and network topology requirements and confirm whether our Dedicated/private deployment options meet your compliance constraints.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Ben: share Redwood intake form and required evidence list (SOC2, encryption, data residency checklist) — aim to have this by EOD Monday.
2) Tom + Vivek: schedule a tech run-through (30m) to confirm PrivateLink and deployment topology — propose Tue 12/4 10am PT.
3) Jane: confirm pilot acceptance criteria you attached and share procurement contact for contract routing.

I attached: redwood-marketplace-intake-form.docx (template), and I've drafted a mutual-action-plan (MAP) — see attached placeholder. Ben, Vivek — please add your notes and I'll consolidate into a version we can send to Acme.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2028 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot opportunity — intake & evidence (Acme Analytics)

+1 on Neha's plan. I reviewed the one-pager and the pilot criteria Jane sent. Action items from my side:
- I'll populate the intake form with the initial offer metadata fields (SKU name, description, billing model, expected monthly run rate) and flag gaps in evidence.
- Tentative evidence checklist (what I'll request from Acme): SOC 2 Type II report, data flow diagram showing no customer data stored on Redwood-managed logs, encryption-at-rest proof, PrivateLink architecture diagram, sample contract language for co-sell leads.

Estimated timeline if Acme responds quickly:
- Intake completed and evidence collected: 7 business days
- Marketplace Ops review + security review: 5 business days
- Listing staging & QA: 3 business days
Total: ~3 weeks to staging (assuming no major gaps).

Vivek — please confirm the PrivateLink topology and any additional infra notes you want me to ask Acme for. Monica — once we have intake and timeline I'll prep the CS onboarding checklist and a pilot success metric sheet for customer success handoff.

I'll attach the populated intake form and a draft MAP (mutual-action-plan) for Neha to send to Acme.

Attachments: acme_marketplace_intake_filled.xlsx (stub), mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf

- Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-analytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@blueridgeconsulting.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@marketplace.amazonaws.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Dec 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot opportunity — AWS listing & co-sell scope (confirming kickoff)

Neha / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. We reviewed Ben's intake form and started pulling the SOC2 artifacts and PrivateLink diagram. Confirming the proposed kickoff on Tue 12/4 was tight for our legal team; can we shift the initial technical sync to Wed 12/6 9am PT? Tom (Blue Ridge) is available then and will bring network diagrams.

Next items from Acme:
- Procurement contact: procurement@acme-analytics.com (I'll cc going forward).
- We'll deliver SOC2 summary and PrivateLink diagram by EOB Monday 12/3.
- We also want a short SLA addendum for the pilot that covers uptime targets and lead routing expectations. Can Redwood share a template SLA appendix?

We'll confirm and send calendar invites after you confirm the 12/6 slot. Appreciate the momentum here — looking forward to a clean pilot.

Best,
Jane
